name: Improved Topological Simplification via Gradient Reversal
definition: A method to modify a scalar field to correspond to a simplified contour tree by reversing gradient flow along a path from a saddle to an extremum, avoiding the visual artifacts of simply 'chopping off' peaks.
summary: Improved Topological Simplification via Gradient Reversal modifies scalar fields by reversing gradient flow along tubes to remove topological features without visual artifacts, ensuring smoother isosurface evolution than simple pruning.
